description: Use this when the user wants printable name tags, name badges, a name tag template, place cards or table tent cards for a list of people. Send the whole guest list in guests (array of names or objects, pasted lines, or CSV text with first, last, company, table); everything else is optional: event name, sort (as given, last name, first name, table), style (classic, bold, minimal), accent colour, paper (US Letter 5395 badges or A4). Returns a name badge PDF (8 per sheet) and a folded tent place card PDF (2 per page) plus a preview. Does not make address labels, business cards, seating charts or wristbands.

accent.description: Accent colour as hex or a colour name, e.g. #7A3E9D (default), navy, teal.

event.description: Event name printed small on each badge and place card, e.g. Spring Gala 2026.

event_name.description: Same as event; used when event is not sent.

guests.description: The guest list: an array of names ("Jane Doe"), an array of objects ({first, last, company, table}), or pasted text with one guest per line or CSV with a header such as first,last,company,table. Example: ["Jane Doe, Acme Corp, Table 4", "Raj Patel"].

paper.description: letter (default: 5395-size badges, 8 per sheet) or a4 (generic 90 x 60 mm badges, 8 per sheet).

show_company.description: Print the company or role line. Default true; send false to hide it.

show_table.description: Print table numbers when the list has them. Default true; send false to hide them.

sort.description: Order: as_given (default), last_name, first_name or table. Example: last_name.

style.description: Badge style: classic (event name and a rule, default), bold (colour header band) or minimal (name only, event small at the bottom).

name: generate_name_tags
title: Generate name tags
